## History

Oliver Sloane was an active member of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society). He attended a society meeting where members expressed outrage over Judson Parker's plan to rent his fences for advertising. After an initial committee sent to reason with Judson returned unsuccessful, Oliver remained part of the society's ongoing efforts to protect the village's appearance.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P2](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0002), [v2 IX A Question of Color P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 IX A Question of Color P4](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0004), [v2 IX A Question of Color P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005), [v2 IX A Question of Color P6](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0006), +36 more_
